note: Canonical machine-readable compatibility matrix. Single source of truth for ResearchPass, which renders per-branch docs/compatibility/THIS_BRANCH.md and per-series release notes. Faithful projection of docs/compatibility/RULES.md + MATRIX.md. Edit ONLY on canonical 19.0; identical on every branch.

kinds.transform: compiler rewrites the golden 19.0 form for the listed series
kinds.identity: golden form is valid on all series; no transform

rules.title: Manifest version prefix
rules.summary: Rewrite the leading 19.0 of __manifest__.py 'version' to the target series.

rules.title: group_expand callback signature
rules.summary: Append the order param to _read_group_stage_ids (and its call sites) for <=17.

rules.title: aggregator -> group_operator
rules.summary: Rename field kwarg aggregator -> group_operator for <=17 (future modules only).

rules.title: <list> -> <tree>
rules.summary: Rename <list>/</list> -> <tree>/</tree> and view_mode token list -> tree for <=17.

rules.title: Kanban card template name
rules.summary: Rename t-name=card -> kanban-box for <=17 (card is a HARD requirement on 19).

rules.title: Chatter arch (legacy oe_chatter div)
rules.summary: Legacy oe_chatter div accepted 14-19; no transform (new <chatter/> since 18.0).

rules.title: Kanban font-awesome title
rules.summary: Golden ensures <i class=fa> has a title attribute (accessibility).

rules.title: states/attrs forbidden
rules.summary: Golden must NOT emit states/attrs (removed at 17.0); use invisible/readonly domains.

rules.title: search <group expand> forbidden
rules.summary: Golden must NOT emit expand on <group> (removed from the group RNG in 19.0).

rules.title: Fully-qualified group xmlids
rules.summary: Prefix view/menuitem groups= xmlids with module. (version-independent correctness).

rules.title: attrs <-> invisible domains
rules.summary: Rewrite unified modifiers to legacy attrs for <=16 (mapping unvalidated; Draft => not auto-applied).

rules.title: res.groups category_id optional
rules.summary: category_id optional on all series; no transform.

rules.title: QWeb report + paperformat
rules.summary: No structural transform; manifest data ordering via ManifestPass.

rules.title: Asset bundle declaration
rules.summary: For 14.0 emit an XML web.assets_backend template instead of the manifest assets dict (future OWL modules).

rules.title: mail.template jinja <-> qweb
rules.summary: For 14.0 rewrite qweb/inline_template mail.template forms back to jinja (${...}, % if %).

rejected.reason: golden already uses legacy oe_chatter div (accepted 14-19)
